subject: Close timeline: updated checkpoints & contingency triggers (Sofia Tech)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Tech <sofia@sofiatech.com>, procure@sofiatech.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close timeline: updated checkpoints & contingency triggers (Sofia Tech)

Hi Sofia / procurement team —

Quick status and ask from our side as we run through the MAP checkpoints for the go-live window originally targeted for 2028-03-31. I updated the attached MAP (SofiaTech_MAP_v2.xlsx) to show where we are today. Short summary: 

- Security review (third-party pen test): report expected by 03/22 but tests uncovered two medium issues; remediation now estimated 5 business days.
- Procurement PO: legal approval step is pending internal budget code assignment on your side — procurement says earliest 03/28.
- Integration QA: a flaky regression in the auth flow has widened the regression window; dev estimate ~4 business days to stabilize.

Combined, these point to a ~10–14 business-day slippage risk to the target close if we do not run parallel mitigations. I'm proposing two things:

1) A short re-baseline option: move close target to 2028-04-14 and adopt staged handoffs (initial admin access + API smoke tests, then full data migration).
2) A contingency trigger ladder (in the MAP): if PO not received by 03/24 OR security remediation not started by 03/23, we shift to a canary roll (reduced scope) and schedule an SLA/funding credit discussion.

Please review the attached MAP and the draft SOW updates in the PDF — I highlighted the staged-deliverables timeline. If you can confirm procurement's internal date and any blockers by EOD Monday (03/19), we can lock either the re-baseline or the contingency lane and communicate that to executive stakeholders.

Attachments: SofiaTech_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP with triggers), SOW_draft_v3.pdf (staged-deliverables).

Thanks —
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
+t (415) 555-0123
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 17 Mar 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close timeline: updated checkpoints & contingency triggers (Sofia Tech)

Tessa —

Thanks for the concise breakdown. I reviewed the MAP and agree the three items are the top slippage drivers. Recommended immediate actions:

- Escalate procurement date to Sofia execs (we should ask for an explicit PO-by date, not a best-effort). If they push back, request a signed conditional PO with payment milestone at canary handoff.
- Offer a short credit (1 week token credit) to move the conversation; keep it as negotiable leverage only if they block the PO path.
- Prepare an internal exec note for 03/20 which outlines business impact and asks for approval to shift to the re-baseline (2028-04-14) if triggers fire. I'll draft the note — Tessa, can you confirm if we have any legal constraints on conditional PO language?

One tactical ask: mark the MAP triggers with exact timestamps (EOB PST on the day) so there's no ambiguity.

On the quoting: "On Fri, 16 Mar 2028 at 09:12, Tessa Morgan wrote:"
> Quick status and ask from our side as we run through the MAP checkpoints for the go-live window originally targeted for 2028-03-31.

I'll take the exec draft; Karthik, please confirm fallback runbook (canary scope + acceptance criteria).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Tech <sofia@sofiatech.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@sofiatech.com
Date: Sun, 18 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close timeline: updated checkpoints & contingency triggers (Sofia Tech)

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the update and the attachments. Short answers from procurement/security side:

- Procurement: internal cost center routing delayed; we now expect PO earliest 2028-03-28. We can expedite if the cost code is approved by our finance lead (I've asked for an update Monday).
- Security: pen test team will provide remediation steps by 2028-03-22; we cannot start remediation earlier than that.

Given those two signals, Sofia Tech prefers the staged handoff approach you outlined rather than an outright push to the 03/31 target. We are prepared to accept the canary scope approach (admin/API smoke first) and complete the full migration once PO is in place and the pen test remediation is verified.

Please send a one-page rebaseline with clear milestones and acceptance criteria so my team can share with finance/legal.

— Sofia
Sofia Petrov
Head of Platform | Sofia Tech
sofia@sofiatech.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Tech <sofia@sofiatech.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Mar 2028 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close timeline: updated checkpoints & contingency triggers (Sofia Tech)

All —

Thanks for the confirmations. Per Marissa's note and Sofia's reply, we are executing the following formal rebaseline and contingency plan effective immediately:

- New target close: 2028-04-14 (final cutover).
- Canary (phase 1) scope: admin console access + API smoke tests + telemetry validation. Acceptance criteria: 3 consecutive days of smoke tests with <1% error rate and KV cache hit >85%.
- Trigger conditions to move to canary: PO not received by 2028-03-24 EOB PST OR security remediation not started by 2028-03-23 EOB PST.
- Financial fallback: if canary is invoked and PO remains outstanding after 10 business days, open credit discussion (prelim: 1 week token credit) to keep momentum.
- Owners: Tessa — customer comms & PO follow; Marissa — exec escalation note for 03/20; Karthik — runbook for canary and rollback (attached as a short checklist in the MAP).

I'll circulate a 1-page rebaseline summary and update the MAP spreadsheet with exact timestamps. Tessa — please confirm once you have Sofia's finance lead reply; we'll queue the exec note after that.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions Delivery | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: SofiaTech_MAP_v2.xlsx, SOW_draft_v3.pdf
